name: Ithaca365 — Multi-Season Autonomous Driving Dataset
description: Multi-season repeat-route autonomous driving benchmark created by Cornell University. Recorded in Ithaca, New York, over a 15 km fixed route driven 40 separate times across an entire year under diverse, challenging conditions including fresh snow, sleet, wet roads, freezing rain, night, and direct sun glare. Equipped with two 32-beam Velodyne LiDARs, stereo perspective cameras, and an Applanix POS LV navigation unit, featuring 6,110 reference frames annotated with 3D bounding boxes.
